name: Doc Detective

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  doc-detective:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: doc-detective/github-action@v2
        with:
